limitations: Boundary driver used identical frozen code and quota-only CPU configuration, but these single runs are not paired speed evidence.
For very short stages memory.stat counters can lag; compare continuous samples and RssAnon, and use 1m/2m for the main resident-memory observation.
The retention-v2 diagnostic takes three extra snapshots 0.5 seconds apart after each timed operation; the settling delay is excluded from stage seconds and explicitly recorded.
Rollback leaves anonymous high-water memory in both versions; no claim of immediate heap return or arbitrary transaction-size safety.
First failing baseline size is 2m, while candidate passes the predeclared 2m cap. Exact failure thresholds were not searched.
Raw io.stat is uncalibrated on a shared WSL device.
Checkpoint helper is separate from the production executable and is individually hashed.
